method: Chromium over loopback HTTP. DOM actions are real UI interactions; explicitly marked fixtures are not natural full-run playthroughs. Automated card policy reads engine state. Viewports are emulated, not physical phones.

results.name: Fresh browser creates a usable v2 profile without phantom rewards
Legacy v1 unlock migrates once and survives refresh
Mode, seed, contract and challenge selections enter the actual run
First battle is playable and a stable checkpoint resumes after refresh
Full backups restore normal fields and reject damaged data transactionally
Refreshing after end-turn resolves the saved enemy phase exactly once
Rejected localStorage writes show an actionable warning while manual backup remains usable
Malformed local run JSON is reported without silently overwriting the original
Only one vault echo is selected; the first three battles consume it once
Passing another run’s first region restores older echoes, but never the echo carried in this run
A real matching weapon or relic acquired before the first battle survives all three echo victories
Abandoning cannot refresh echo readiness or award settlement repeatedly
Settlement summary reflects the run and its configuration can be copied for sharing
Pasted configuration changes preparation while preserving the active checkpoint and explains unavailable echoes
Full, reduced and off equipment visuals preserve identical combat rules
Replay setup, vault, battle and results fit 320, 390 and 1440 widths
